result_text:
I changed the `all_files.zip` export in `DataExporter.java` so it looks up and names each scope file list from the configured aspect, the same way the loose `aspect_<name>.txt` files are written. The reports module compiles and its offline tests pass (`mvn -q -o -pl reports test` printed no failures).

The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`, in the block that builds the zip. The five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals are replaced by a loop over the five scope aspects. Each entry name comes from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, and the content is read from the same file. With the default config the entries and their order stay the same. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`, so `all_files.zip` is written and `git-history.zip` follows as before.

I did not run the export end-to-end with a renamed aspect, and I did not add a test for it. Nothing was committed.

`codeanalyzer/.../LandscapeAnalyzer.java` (lines 280–284) has the same fixed `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt` literal. I left it alone since the task was the export, but it will break the same way for a renamed aspect.
